note: The halo family. Leif, 2026-09-05: 'so create many different versions including one which is a perfect recreation.' One design language, several boards. Each variant states what it is FOR, what it copies, what it changes, and what it cannot have.

variants.name: Replica
variants.purpose: A part-for-part recreation of the AirTag's internals, as close as anything buyable allows. The reference against which every other variant's divergence is measured.
copies: a 32 Mbit SPI NOR flash on a REGULATED 1.8 V rail as Apple does, via a buck and a load switch
a class-D audio amplifier driving a voice coil
the TPS62746 buck, FPF2487 load switch and TLV9001 op-amp
five 100 uF bulk capacitors for the five-removals reset
0.3 mm annular board with a centre hole
three sprung battery contacts, two positive rails sensed
changes: the U1 ultra-wideband module cannot be bought at any price — the footprint and its feed exist, unpopulated

Apple's laser-structured antennas need tooling we do not have — and whether that is two of the three or all three is OPEN: the coil at the board's centre is wound wire rather than a structured trace, but whether it is the NFC antenna or the speaker's voice coil is unresolved, because its leads land on pads this repo attributes to the voice coil while Apple's own arrow labels the annulus NFC. The physics favours NFC at about 0.50 ohm against the several ohms a voice coil needs. If it is the voice coil, the gap is three. The BLE inverted-F and the UWB patch use a flex or an etched carrier, with the difference measured rather than hidden
any Apple part that is obsolete or unbuyable is substituted by closest function, each one named
cannot: Precision Finding — no U1, and the accessory programme is incompatible with publishing
appearing inside Apple's own Find My app — needs a per-unit token burned at the factory
variants.why: Leif asked for it directly, and it is the honest baseline: it turns every divergence elsewhere from an assertion into a measured difference.

variants.name: Core
variants.purpose: The open product: cheapest to make, easiest to embed, and the one that ships. A functional equivalent rather than a copy.
copies: every function of the AirTag except Precision Finding
changes: no external flash — the firmware is 1.27 percent of the SoC's own memory
no audio amplifier — a bare piezo bender driven anti-phase from two pins
antennas etched in the board's own copper rather than on a plastic carrier
0.6 mm solid board rather than 0.3 mm annular
both Apple's and Google's networks advertising in one event
peer ranging by Bluetooth Channel Sounding
variants.why: About $6 a unit against Apple's $29 retail, an antenna 3.7 dB better than theirs, and a circuit that drops into any host board.

variants.name: Block
variants.purpose: The circuit as a solder-down module anyone can put in their own product, in any outline.
changes: castellated edge, roughly 15 by 20 mm
the host board provides the cell, the sounder and the outline
ships as a KiCad design block carrying schematic AND routed layout, plus an integration sheet stating the antenna keep-out, because a block carries no design rules
cannot: guaranteeing the host does not flood ground over the antenna — hence the integration sheet
variants.why: GOAL.md deliverable 2, and the thing no open tracker has ever shipped.
variants.status: DESIGN BLOCK EXPORT PROVEN, BOARD NOT DRAWN

variants.name: Ranger
variants.purpose: Centimetre ranging where Channel Sounding is not enough, for the owner's own fleet.
variants.soc: nRF54L10 plus a DW3110-class ultra-wideband transceiver
changes: the reserved ultra-wideband footprint is populated
a second antenna
about 8.86 dollars more per unit, and a shorter battery life at any useful ranging rate
cannot: talking to an iPhone's Precision Finding — the handshake needs Apple's programme
being cheap: no ultra-wideband part is buyable in quantity today
variants.why: Leif's digital twin needs relative position between his own sensors; this is the accurate fallback if Channel Sounding disappoints in a real building.

variants.name: Plus
variants.purpose: Everything that gets ahead of Apple rather than level with them.
changes: sensor telemetry carried in the advertisement's spare status bits, so a tag reports temperature or motion through the crowd network with no gateway
energy harvesting under assessment for a tag that never needs a battery change
a companion app doing arrow-and-distance by Channel Sounding, which is Precision Finding without Apple
variants.why: The concepts lane is costing each of these now. Ideas are cheap; this variant exists so the good ones have somewhere to land.

variants.name: Card
variants.purpose: A wallet-thickness tag, which is the form Apple does not make at all.
changes: rectangular card outline, a rechargeable or a soldered cell rather than a CR2032
the antenna redrawn for a long thin ground plane, which is a genuinely different problem from a 26 mm disc
cannot: a user-replaceable coin cell, so the child-safety rule applies differently
variants.why: Every competitor sells one and Apple does not. The embeddable block makes it nearly free to try.
